Eligibility Criteria
To qualify for the UpRock airdrop, participants must meet the following criteria:
Voting Participation in Jupiter’s LFG Rounds
All voters during
LFG Round #2
are eligible.
Additional airdrop for those who voted for
UpRock in LFG Round #1 and LFG Round #2
.

Loyalty Bonus
is given to users who voted for UpRock in both rounds.

will be distributed in
July
as staking rewards for users who participated in the
LFG Launchpad
.

Additional Information
UpRock has outlined a
Fair Distribution Roadmap
to ensure a fair and sustainable token ecosystem. The key phases include:
Fair Bandwidth Phase (April 26, 2024):
Rewards distributed based on individual device scores to prevent exploitation.
Fair Bonus System (April 29, 2024):
New users receive a
2 UPT bonus
upon setting up a profile.
Referral rewards
: 10x kickback on referral earnings in their first week.
Device Scoring (May 5, 2024):
A scoring mechanism ensures fair mining rewards.
Emulation/cloning penalties
: By May 5, any emulator will receive
0 UPT/hour
.
Fixed Monthly Supply (May 7, 2024):
4.2M UPT tokens distributed per month, decreasing
16% monthly
.
GEO Coverage (May 9, 2024):
Incentives for expanding UpRock mining to
new geographic locations
.
Proof of Prestige (May 12, 2024):
Verification process to
validate genuine devices
.
Ongoing Purge (Before TGE):
Fraudulent accounts removed
before Token Generation Event (TGE).
Token Generation Event (TGE):
Rewards will be
locked for 3 days post-TGE
before they become claimable.
This roadmap ensures that UpRock remains
fair, secure, and rewarding
for genuine contributors.
